description: This file contains shell functions for preparing and managing pull request branches, including initializing preparation, validating commits, pushing changes, synchronizing heads, and running the entire preparation process.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the preparation branch for a given pull request.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves the name of the preparation branch based on the pull request number.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Verifies that the local prep branch contains the expected commit SHA.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the preparation environment for a pull request, fetching branches and setting up context files.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates the latest commit message in the PR to ensure it does not contain PR number metadata or contributor thanks.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR, verifies head SHA, and updates context files.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Synchronizes the prep branch with the latest main branch, rebasing if necessary, and updates context files.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Runs the full preparation process: init, gates, and push for a PR.
